# Samuele Bovo

**Animal Genetics · Bioinformatics · Computational Biology**

Assistant Professor in Animal Genetics  
University of Bologna, Italy

**Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)
Postdoctoral Global Fellow — Project ABPhenomics**

My background is in bioinformatics and systems
biology, including computational methods for
molecular interaction networks and omics data
integration.

My research spans animal genetics and genomics,
from complex traits and pig metabolomics and
phenomics to population genomics, biodiversity
and molecular traceability. 

:::

## Research areas

::: {.grid .research-grid}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">01</span>

### Animal Genomics & Phenomics

Genetic architecture of complex traits,
genome-wide association studies, pig
metabolomics and molecular phenotypes.

:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">02</span>

### Multi-Omics & Systems Biology

Integration of genomic, metabolomic and
phenotypic datasets, molecular networks
and functional interpretation of
biological processes.

:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">03</span>

### Biodiversity & Population Genomics

Genetic diversity, population structure,
environmental genomics and molecular
approaches to biodiversity monitoring.

:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.research-card}

<span class="research-number">04</span>

### Bioinformatics & Machine Learning

Development and application of computational
methods, statistical modelling and machine
learning approaches to biological datasets.

:::
